verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a Pay As You Go plan with $200 free credit and no minimums, but no published per-minute or per-hour rates and no itemized add-on prices (for example diarization, redaction, or Audio Intelligence) that an agent could use to compute a job's cost before submitting it. CLI usage management is an adjacent capability for tracking usage after the fact, not upfront pricing. A community report that pricing could not be found on the website points the same way but carries little weight.
